name: The Commish
description: Tony Scali is a former Brooklyn cop now the Police Commissioner of a small upstate city. But for Scali, this is no desk job. He's a tough yet compassionate boss, a loving husband and father, and a hands-on law enforcer with an unorthodox style of bending the rules. From parenthood to politics, from sex crimes to murder cases, one man takes it day-to-day with offbeat humor and street- smart skill.

videos.title: In the Best of Families
videos.overview: Tony is threatened with criminal negligence after the son of a prominent lawyer hangs himself in his cell.

videos.title: Do You See What I See?
videos.overview: The commissioner sets out to trap a serial rapist in a Santa Claus mask who's been terrorizing the city.

videos.title: The Poisoned Tree
videos.overview: Rachel refuses to believe Tony when he tells her that her school teacher colleague, Jim Hollister, is a child molester.

videos.title: Nothing to Fear But ...
videos.overview: After receiving a pair of baffling death threats, Tony initiates around-the-clock surveillance of his unsuspecting family.

videos.title: A Matter of Life or Death (1)
videos.overview: Tony initiates a sweep to find a pair of missing cops; devises an ingenious way of keeping an habitually drunk driver off the road; and deftly handles an "extraterrestrial," all the while being scrutinized by a committee searching for a new police commissioner for New York City.

videos.title: A Matter of Life or Death (2)
videos.overview: Two missing cops have been found under water, there a jail hunger strike going on and tony's up for the nypd commissioner job.

videos.title: Behind the Storm Door
videos.overview: Tony is pursued by a woman he suspects is filing false complaints.

videos.title: The Hatchet
videos.overview: Tony butts heads with both a tough cop who is overzealous in his handling of criminals, and a hard-nosed management consultant hired by the city in a cost-cutting effort.

videos.title: Two Confessions
videos.overview: Tony is doubly stymied when identical twins both initially confess to the same murder, then, in a surprise about-face, accuse each other of the crime. Also, Arnie finds romance with a kindred soul, a phone-sex operator named Gloria.

videos.title: Commissioner's Ball
videos.overview: A serial killer has been mutilating the bodies of Eastbridge tradsients and homeless people - and Tony begins to suspect the perpetrator's identity.

videos.title: No Greater Gift
videos.overview: During the holiday season, Tony investigates the murder of an elderly woman allegedly killed in her home during a Christmas burglary; matches wits with a mugger, and defends a homeless woman who's been sleeping in the manger of a Holy Family creche.

videos.title: The Fourth Man
videos.overview: After Commissioner Scali's friend and colleague, Chief of Detectives Irv Wallerstein, is struck down during a bloody encounter with hijackers, Tony becomes obsessed with finding the assailant!

videos.title: Charlie Don't Surf
videos.overview: Vietnamese gangs threaten Eastbridge and Tony steps in to help.

videos.title: Skeletons
videos.overview: A mugging triggers a woman's repressed mernosy of her brother's murder, which she witnessed as a child. The suspect, free for the past 35 years, is tracked to the unlikeliest of hiding places by Tony and a visiting friend, L.A. homicide detective Paulie Pentangeli.

videos.title: The Wicked Flee
videos.overview: After seeing his mother killed by a stranger, a boy withdraws deep into himself, prompting a sympathetic Tony to step up his efforts to catch the murderer.

videos.title: True Believers
videos.overview: The unwelcome appearance in Eastbridge of white supremacists leads to a murder, with the suspicion soon arising that one or more of Tony's associates may be implicated.

videos.title: Officer April
videos.overview: After he shoots a woman in a drunken domestic squabble, Officer Kelly becomes the victim of a terrorization campaign.

videos.title: Sex, Lies, and Kerosene
videos.overview: Tony and Paulie investigate a puzzling arson case in which the husband of a beautiful woman appears to have been murdered.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: Tony winds up in one of his own jail cells when he runs afoul of an imperious judge who's hiding a fearsome secret.

videos.title: Shoot the Breeze
videos.overview: Tony attempts to protect an informant from a mysterious hit man, while Stan Kelly enjoys a romantic encounter with a beautiful new Eastbridge arrival.

videos.title: Video Vigilante
videos.overview: Tony is embarrassed, then enraged, as a publicity-seeking "video vigilante" metes out even more bizarre and harsh punishment to offenders.

videos.title: The Puck Stops Here
videos.overview: Mike Cermak - star high-school hockey player, recovering addict, and good friend of the Scali family - becomes a prime drug-ring suspect.

videos.title: Adventures in the Skin Trade (1)
videos.overview: The daughter of one of Tony's friends is missing, so he and Paulie pose as porn film investors to find out the truth.

videos.title: Adventures in the Skin Trade (2)
videos.overview: Tony escapes from the kidnappers with the help of the porn producer and then they pursue a film entrpreneur.

videos.title: Guns & Sons
videos.overview: David is the only witness to a shooting involving his best friend and a bullying classmate. Tony pursues the case unaware of David's knowledge of the shooting.  The victim’s father, skeptical of police justice, plans to mete out his own.

videos.title: The Rolodex Madam
videos.overview: Tony is astonished to discover a wealthy socialite is the proprietor of a prostitution ring. The socialite is murdered, but not before Tony's name is discovered in her rolodex of clients.

videos.title: The Witches of Eastbridge
videos.overview: The town is in shock when a heart is cut from a corpse at the funeral home. Meanwhile, the town believes a recluse taints halloween treats.

videos.title: The Two Faces of Ed
videos.overview: An old friend of Tony's is having marital trouble—which could be causing deadly incidents.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Rachel redecorates. One of Tony's friends, who harbors a secret, is a target from an escaped convict.

videos.title: A Time to Be Born
videos.overview: Rachel goes into labor, Tony is kept away due to a friends crisis.

videos.title: Witness
videos.overview: Rachel becomes the target of a killer when she witnesses a murder whilst grocery shopping.

videos.title: Sleep of the Just
videos.overview: While Tony suffers from loss of sleep after becoming a father again, he puzzles over the case of a rapist who has diplomatic immunity.

videos.title: The Frame
videos.overview: A notorious mob boss retires to Eastbridge and, in turn, the crime rate rises.

videos.title: Stoned
videos.overview: Things are not going well for Tony: he's carjacked of his gift of a new car for Rachel, a patient from psychiatric hospital  escapes, things are further complicated because the escapee is a master of disguise. Tony also suffers with kidney stones, which means that he has to go to hospital leaving Cyd in charge.

videos.title: The Heart is a Lonely Sucker
videos.overview: While Stan is having problems protecting Carmela from a curse, Tony thinks that a video dating service's client is a homicidal thief.

videos.title: The Sharp Pinch
videos.overview: Tony hunts for a kidnapped infant who is seriously ill.

videos.title: Dead Cadet's Society
videos.overview: David's behavior and school works deteriorates. A group of young men from a prep school commit a burglary and one of them suspiciously disappears.

videos.title: Family Business (1)
videos.overview: The son of Nick Collette arrives in Eastbridge, which causes more trouble for Tony and a local businessman.

videos.title: Out of Business (2)
videos.overview: Following on from the previous episode; Nick Collete seeks revenge and Tony continues his crusade to bring him to justice.

videos.title: The Ides of March
videos.overview: A man takes his ex-wife hostage. Things are further complicated by the involvement of one Tony's officers. The psychic who found the ring Tony was giving to Rachel in a previous episode returns, but this time with a warning about Tony's planned anniversary dinner but, is there an ulterior motive?

videos.title: Blue Flu
videos.overview: When budget cuts hit the Eastbridge PD, the majority of officers call in sick. This leaves the remaining officers to tackle a series of "push-in" robberies.  Rachel goes to a her school reunion without Tony, but instead of going by herself she accepts the offer to attend with an old school beau.

videos.title: Eastbridge Boulevard
videos.overview: A new reality police show comes to town. Meanwhile, a former movie star is implicated in her ex lover's murder.

videos.title: Sight Unseen
videos.overview:
A rapist is targeting blind female college students.

Rachel makes an investment in art.

videos.title: The Anti-Commish
videos.overview: Tony receives mysterious telephone calls from someone who can help solve a drug dealer’s murder.  Rachel gets a good job offer that, ultimately, could mean a move to Buffalo.

videos.title: Suffer the Children (1)
videos.overview:
Tony and the head of a juvenile care centre clash when Tony suspects the man is responsible for the disappearance and probable murder of a missing girl. The two have history after the suicide of another girl at the same centre years before.

Tony and Rachel's home life is tested when Rachel relocates to Buffalo.

videos.title: Suffer the Children (2)
videos.overview: Following the discovery of human bones at a location used by the juvenile centre Tony continues to bring his suspect to justice.  Rachel and Tony make a decision about their respective careers.

videos.title: Scali, P.I.
videos.overview:
After their decision regarding their careers Tony struggles to cope with his new job as a P.I. while Rachel finds it much easier to adjust.

He also butts heads with his replacement so he reaches out to Cyd and for help.

videos.title: Burned Out Case
videos.overview: Someone close to David dies as a result of a drug overdose and he struggles to cope with the harsh realities of law enforcement when Tony's hand is forced by outside agencies.  Officers Baker, Kelly and Rose go undercover at a burger joint.

videos.title: The Set-Up
videos.overview: Rachel is being framed for murder after Tony's probe of a criminal network goes wrong.

videos.title: Rising Sun
videos.overview:
Tony's city-council pal won't vote for a Japanese businessman's purchase of prime Eastbridge real estate.

In a second short story arch, juvenile delinquents rob a flower shop.

videos.title: Hero
videos.overview: The Scali's babysitter accuses an Eastbridge high school quarterback of rape, Tony must investigate despite the mixed feelings of the community. Stan's ego is bruised when his girlfriend knocks out a man who punched Stan.

videos.title: Dying Affection
videos.overview:
The police are puzzled by two aged armed robbers; is everything as it seems?

Cyd breaks up with her boyfriend and strange things start happening immediately thereafter.

videos.title: All That Glitters
videos.overview: Stan's fiance, Monica is implicated in assisting in a robbery. Tony discovers Monica was previously in trouble with the law before with her old boyfriend. Meanwhile, Rachel puts Tony on a health plan.

videos.title: Mansion
videos.overview: Amanda Hannington Wallace, the wife of a local multi-millionaire, is found dead her her mansion. When the autopsy is performed, the coronor advises Tony that the death does not look like an accident.

videos.title: A Little Heart
videos.overview: When a donor heart meant for a sick little girl is stolen, Tony heads up a team of detectives bent on finding the heart before anything can happen to it or the little girl. The thief makes themself known when he contacts her desperate parents and demands a $75,000 ransom for the missing heart.

videos.title: Benny
videos.overview: Rachel's cousin Benny is a used car salesman, and Tony doesn't know what to believe when a case involving the murder of a young woman leads him right back to Benny's used car lots. When Tony realises that Benny is involved in drug smuggling, he gives Benny one last chance to explain himself.

videos.title: Keeping Secrets
videos.overview: The recent beatings of many members of the homosexual community prompts Hank Radovich to come out to his fellow officers, none of which are very accepting of the news. While investigating the beatings, John Hibbs is himself taken hostage and beaten, and although he was initially disdainful of Hank's sexual preference, he learns to accept his partner and friend.

videos.title: Dog Days
videos.overview: Cyd finds the body of a young woman who appears to have died from an overdose of angel dust. The only witness is a young man named Billy, who the opposing attorney ridicules during a preliminary hearing because of his physical and mental handicaps. Further investigations lead the cops to a number of recently missing dogs.

videos.title: Father Eddie
videos.overview: A young woman is found dead and evidence leads Tony to a friend of his, a Priest who teaches local kids boxing

videos.title: Bank Job
videos.overview: Tony and Rachel have a fight, and Tony begins throwing himself into his job. When Rachel is taken hostage in a bank robbery and also forced to go on the road, Tony tries his best to get her back, but the FBI soon assumes jurisdiction over the case, leaving Tony out of the loop.

videos.title: Romeo and Juliet
videos.overview: After the body of Gary Ellis is found, the case soon leads Tony to Gideon Fisher, the father of David's girlfriend Sheri. Tony demands that David stop seeing Sheri, but David rebels, and he and Sheri run off together.

videos.title: Security
videos.overview: Residents of an apartment block employ their own security after one of them is attacked and a number of them are burgled. The residents feel safer but a what cost?

videos.title: Dead Drunk
videos.overview: The wife of one of Tony's officers is killed by a drunk driver, leaving him with an eight-year-old daughter. The investigation leads to prominent surgeon Harris Clark who has a history of DUI offences. When Clark gets a suspended sentence and is found dead, suspicion turns to the officer.

videos.title: The Letter of the Law
videos.overview: Rachel is shocked when the mother of one the children she helps doesn't want her daughter's art featured in a magazine. It transpires that her estranged husband is a child molester and the mum's on the run. Elsewhere Tony's suicide awareness program cause a rather strange reaction from an actor neighbour he brought in to help.

videos.title: Sergeant Kelly
videos.overview: More than anything Stan wants to become a sergeant, but the sergeant's test isn't the only obstacle in his way. He also needs to prove that he can follow a case from start to finish. Tony assigns him to the case of drug dealer Terry Ross, which he figures won't be that hard for Stan. Stan soon falls for Gail, Terry's estranged wife, and starts to think everything will be okay.

videos.title: The Iceman Cometh
videos.overview: The force must rally themselves after Stan's death in a car explosion. Tony feels particularly bad, because he can't forget that he was the one who assigned Stan to work on the Ross case in the first place. After promising Stan's parents that he will find the man who killed their son, Tony launches a full-scale war on Terry Ross, not realising that Ross has hired someone to take care of the Scali family once and for all.

videos.title: Against the Wind (1)
videos.overview: After being struck with a ball, Tony is hospitalized and it looks like he is going to be permanently paralyzed. But his family refuses to give up on him, and enlists the help of physiotherapist Dan Boylan to help him walk again. With Tony out of commission, Cyd is put in charge of the murder investigation of officer Joe Ratowski.

videos.title: Against the Wind (2)
videos.overview: Tony's attempts at physical therapy are proving unsuccessful, and despite the love and support of his family he is beginning to lose hope that he will ever walk again, and is preparing to spend the rest of his life in the wheelchair. Cyd has the chance to take a job out of Eastbridge, but doesn't want to leave Tony in a noose. While she considers her decision, she continues to work on the Joe Ratowski murder case, which is looking more and more like an 'inside job'.

videos.title: Working Girls
videos.overview: While investigating an armed robbery, Tony goes undercover and hires an escort to get some important information. He is shocked to see his friend Ralph's daughter, who is barely 18, show up, preparing to spend the night with him. Tony convinces her to get out of drugs and prostition and promises not to tell her father, but when tragedy strikes, Tony has no choice.

videos.title: Born in the USA
videos.overview: Isaac and Grace Caldwell are illegal immigrants who own and operate a small electrical shop. After they witness a murder, Tony has to convince the two to testify, which he does by promising them citizenship. They agree, happy that the child Grace is carrying can be born in America, but joy turns to tragedy when Isaac is shot.

videos.title: Who Do You Trust?
videos.overview: While an officer who is posing as a crooked cop in order to expose a crime ring which be be the genuine article who has problems as tony also suspects him.

videos.title: Nancy with the Laughing Face
videos.overview: While working on an embezzlement and a kinapping case Paulie starts to becomes to emotionally involved.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: A corrupt ex-officer that Tony imprisoned seeks revenge upon his release.

videos.title: Head Case
videos.overview: Tony uncovers a plot to frame an innocent man for the murder of a fellow patient at a mental institution.

videos.title: The Lady Vanishes
videos.overview: An old student of Rachel's starts hinting that he saw his stepmother commit murder.

videos.title: Ghost
videos.overview:
Officer Lopez is suspended after he fatally shoots a robber the press have nicknamed 'The Ghost'. Later, Tony believes that he see's the same man in a pawnshop.

At home, the Scali's hire a contractor to do some simple DIY, but the costs keep spiralling.

videos.title: A Christmas Story
videos.overview: An old friend of Tony gets his life back on track with help from a retirement hotel resident.

videos.title: Hidden
videos.overview: Tony helps a man find his estranged family who entered and then left a witness protection program. The family are also hunted by a mob boss.

videos.title: The Johnny Club
videos.overview: David is caught shoplifting, meanwhile Tony finds out an accident victim was in debt to a loan shark and that he was also a polygamist.

videos.title: The Golden Years
videos.overview: A gangster who Tony's mother was dating is found killed. The main suspect is Tony's father.

videos.title: Accused
videos.overview: Tony is accused of sexual harassment by an computer technician.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: A serial sex-offender is found not guilty then later murdered. A prior victim's relative targets those he feels responsible for the failure to jail him.

videos.title: Cry Wolf
videos.overview: While trying to solve a major gold robbery, Tony must rely on help from a conman.

videos.title: Brooklyn
videos.overview: Tony and Paulie travel to Brooklyn to help investigate the reopening of the case of their fallen friend and officer.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Tony and Paulie take on a shady investment broker at his own game. All the while, Rachel and Tony are in emotional turmoil awaiting the results of Rachel's breast cancer test results.

videos.title: The Kid
videos.overview: A hopeless teenager gets a help from Tony and Paulie.

videos.title: Off Broadway (1)
videos.overview: While investigating the murder of his friend's daughter, tony gets help from a New York police officer.

videos.title: Off Broadway (2)
videos.overview: Tony and Connie Muldoon close in on the serial killer, Connie's daughter might be the next victim.

videos.title: In the Shadow of the Gallows (1)
videos.overview: Tony faces the biggest challenge of his career when an murder case from his past resurfaces.

videos.title: In the Shadow of the Gallows (2)
videos.overview: Tony faces the biggest challenge of his career when an murder case from his past resurfaces.

videos.title: Father Image (1)
videos.overview: During a high - profile serial murder case a old mentor of tony becomes involved with the case.

videos.title: Father Image (2)
videos.overview: During a high - profile serial murder case a old mentor of tony becomes involved with the case.

videos.title: Redemption (1)
videos.overview: While on the trail of an arsonist, the commish notices that all the clues point to the wife father's.

videos.title: Redemption (2)
videos.overview: While on the trail of an arsonist, the commish notices that all the clues point to the wife father's.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 5 nominations total
